name: cascade_delete
description: In the DELETE /api/customers/:c_custkey handler, the transaction explicitly executes `DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?` before deleting the customer. This matches the unsafe application-level child-row delete signal, because `/api/orders/monthly-trend` aggregates all historical rows from `orders`, so deleting a customer also removes order data that another endpoint expects to remain observable after the parent is gone.
